metadata.title: Evaluate to true if the independent shellcommand test is properly supported
metadata.description: This definition is intended to evaluate to true if the interpreter properly supports the independent shellcommand test.

notes.note: This test definition requires the presence of target files in /opt/support. For more information, see the accompanying README.

criterion.comment: Simple execution of a system command, 'ls -l'.
Employ an object pattern to filter STDOUT results.
Employ an object pattern to capture a sub-expression.
Expect 'error'. Exercise use of behavior - error_if_stderr_exists
Expect 'error'. Exercise use of behavior - error_if_exit_status_not_0

shellcommand_test.comment: Simple execution of a system command, 'ls -l'.
Employ an object pattern to filter STDOUT results.
Employ an object pattern to capture a sub-expression.
Expect 'error'. Exercise use of a behavior - 'error_if_stderr_exists'.
Expect 'error'. Exercise use of a behavior - 'error_if_exit_status_not_0'.

shellcommand_object.comment: Run 'ls -l' against installed support files with an object pattern.
Run 'ls -l' against installed support files with an object pattern containing a subexpression capture.
Attempt to run a non-existent command to create STDERR output and test behavior 'error_if_stderr_exists'.
Attempt to run a non-existent command to create exit_statu other than '0' and test behavior 'error_if_exit_status_not_0'.

shellcommand_state.comment: Confirm existence of text support files.
Confirm collection of only those lines containing the word 'Document'.
